name: Chad
source:
Chad is a very sociable figure with a gentlemanly air. He is always smiling and has a serene appearance; however, you can never quite guess what his real intentions are because of his appearances. There is a rumor he is a con man and would do anything for money, but is it for real…?

[From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=912279494]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
